title: driverFiles
responsibility: Read driver JSON and live slot metadata without writes, prune dead PIDs, and classify job phases consistently with backfill.

inputs.name: driverJson.path
inputs.description: Filesystem address to read; JSON and filesystem failures propagate. Historical identity uses only its containing folder as a fallback.

inputs.name: driverJson.fallback
inputs.description: Value returned only when the JSON snapshot path does not exist; invalid existing JSON still throws.

inputs.name: driverProcesses.root
inputs.description: Driver collection root used to resolve slot task and result paths and scope live process discovery. Only code_task slot processes belonging to this root contribute model capacity.

inputs.name: livePid.pid
inputs.description: Positive process ID checked with signal zero. Omitted, malformed, inaccessible or dead processes return false.

inputs.name: driverJobType.name
inputs.description: Task or collection name inspected for reverify, contract, stub, smell, video or component prefixes; unmatched names use code.

outputs.name: driverJson
outputs.description: Parsed existing JSON or the caller fallback for a missing file; no snapshot is rewritten.

outputs.name: driverProcesses
outputs.description: Live code_task slot metadata extracted from ps without printing command lines or environments.

outputs.name: livePid
outputs.description: Whether a positive process ID is alive and accessible to signal zero.

outputs.name: driverJobType
outputs.description: Stable phase label used by both live queued tasks and historical duration samples.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Existing malformed JSON is rejected instead of silently presenting an empty queue; filesystem and ps failures also propagate.
